name: § 24, point a
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the EU joint undertakings for the financial year 2023
part_text: (a) the situations of the Innovative Health Initiative Joint Undertaking and of the Chips Joint Undertaking, for both of which the Court of Auditors observed weaknesses in the design and evaluation of one significant procurement procedure; takes note of the fact that the Joint Undertakings are ready to take action in these specific cases and to improve their procurement procedures, which is the minimum that can be expected, as these basic rules must apply to everyone;
